key_insight: DEFEAT enables gradient-based crystal design by jointly optimizing composition and structure, including semiconductor candidates targeting a photovoltaic-relevant band gap.
engineering_relevance: The approach could accelerate solar-absorber discovery by searching elemental choices, stoichiometry, atomic positions, and lattice geometry together.
method: Extend pretrained EquiformerV3 to continuous species weights and site occupancies without fractional-data retraining.
Combine property-model gradients with a machine-learned energy penalty.
Optimize candidate crystals and validate band gaps and stability with first-principles calculations.
evidence_signal: SCAN calculations confirmed ten novel crystal structures with band gaps within 20% of a 1.34 eV target on their respective raw or empirically corrected scales, all within 70 meV/atom of the DFT hull.
watch_item: Training-functional band-gap errors propagate into designs unless corrected in the objective; target gaps alone do not establish solar-cell performance.
paper_title: Inverse design of superconductors and semiconductors with differentiable foundation models
